items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: make this date with Lee Morlin and Horace Silver and Billy and myself -- it was Lee's first date day

ctx.x: Those were the days of Ferguson.

Yeah. Well, anyway, Kenny Drew and I both said, 'Well, man, you got to get somebody else to make that gig.' And he fumed and screamed and said, 'No, you're gonna make it -- I brought you out of Chicago.' So we finally said, 'Okay'. So we come down to Philly and this was when I was introduced to Lee Morgan. Lee made the gig. Back then, he and Lee were very good buddies, and he played at the old Blue Note.
Now we went up ... the thing was on a Wednesday. Now, I had a hole in my tooth that I was walking around with
